UNION ALL SELECT 'assets_under_management_amt', 'HDQuanLyQuy_06014', '%hoạt động%', '170103', 'Tổng' UNION ALL SELECT 'capital_adequacy_ratio', 'BangTongHop_06013', '%an toàn tài chính%', '4055', 'Giá trị rủi ro/ vốn khả dụng' UNION ALL SELECT 'net_profit_after_tax_amt', 'BCKetQuaHoatDongKinhDoanh', '%báo cáo tài chính%', '60', 'Kỳ này' UNION ALL SELECT 'owner_equity_amt', 'BangCanDoiKeToan', '%báo cáo tài chính%', '400', 'Số cuối kỳ' UNION ALL SELECT 'portfolio_management_contract_count', 'Chung_TinhHinhQLDMDT_06020', '%hoạt động%', '180101', 'Kỳ báo cáo'), target_cell AS (SELECT fmr_sheet.fmr_sheet_code, fmr_sheet.cell_id, kpi_spec.kpi_key FROM fmr_sheet INNER JOIN fund_management_report ON fund_management_report.fmr_id = fmr_sheet.fmr_id AND fund_management_report.src_stm_code = 'FMS_RPT_TEMP' INNER JOIN kpi_spec ON kpi_spec.sheet_nm = fmr_sheet.fmr_sheet_nm AND LOWER(fund_management_report.fmr_nm) LIKE kpi_spec.rpt_nm_like WHERE fmr_sheet.src_stm_code = 'FMS_SHEET' AND (SELECT MAX(r.label_nm) FROM fmr_sheet r WHERE r.fmr_sheet_code = fmr_sheet.fmr_sheet_code AND r.src_stm_code = 'FMS_SHEET' AND r.row_index = fmr_sheet.row_index AND r.column_index = (SELECT MIN(h.column_index) FROM fmr_sheet h WHERE h.fmr_sheet_code = fmr_sheet.fmr_sheet_code AND h.src_stm_code = 'FMS_SHEET' AND h.label_nm = 'Mã chỉ tiêu' AND h.row_index = (SELECT MIN(m.row_index) FROM fmr_sheet m WHERE m.fmr_sheet_code = fmr_sheet.fmr_sheet_code AND m.src_stm_code = 'FMS_SHEET'))) = kpi_spec.row_code AND (SELECT STRING_AGG(lbl.label_nm, ' >> ' ORDER BY lbl.row_index, lbl.column_index) FROM fmr_sheet lbl WHERE lbl.fmr_sheet_code = fmr_sheet.fmr_sheet_code AND lbl.src_stm_code = 'FMS_SHEET' AND lbl.cell_id <> fmr_sheet.cell_id AND lbl.label_nm IS NOT NULL AND lbl.row_index < fmr_sheet.row_index AND fmr_sheet.column_index BETWEEN lbl.column_index AND lbl.column_index + COALESCE(lbl.column_span, 1) - 1) = kpi_spec.col_label), latest_val AS (SELECT fmr_submission.fmc_id, target_cell.kpi_key, TO_NUMBER(REPLACE(CAST(fmr_value.cell_val AS VARCHAR2(4000)), '%', '') DEFAULT NULL ON CONVERSION ERROR) AS val, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY fmr_submission.fmc_id, target_cell.kpi_key ORDER BY fmr_value.rpt_year DESC, fmr_value.period_val DESC, fmr_submission.submitted_dt DESC) AS rn FROM fmr_value INNER JOIN fmr_submission ON fmr_submission.fmr_submission_id = fmr_value.fmr_submission_id AND fmr_submission.src_stm_code = 'FMS_RPT_MEMBER' INNER JOIN target_cell ON target_cell.fmr_sheet_code = fmr_value.fmr_sheet_code AND target_cell.cell_id = fmr_value.cell_id WHERE fmr_submission.record_tp = '2' AND fmr_submission.record_status_code IN ('2','3','5','10') AND fmr_value.src_stm_code = 'FMS_RPT_VALUES' AND fmr_submission.submitted_dt <= :etl_date), latest_report AS (SELECT fmc_id, MAX(CASE WHEN kpi_key = 'certified_practitioner_staff_count' THEN val END) AS certified_practitioner_staff_count, MAX(CASE WHEN kpi_key = 'assets_under_management_amt' THEN val END) AS assets_under_management_amt, MAX(CASE WHEN kpi_key = 'capital_adequacy_ratio' THEN val END) AS capital_adequacy_ratio, MAX(CASE WHEN kpi_key = 'net_profit_after_tax_amt' THEN val END) AS net_profit_after_tax_amt, MAX(CASE WHEN kpi_key = 'owner_equity_amt' THEN val END) AS owner_equity_amt, MAX(CASE WHEN kpi_key = 'portfolio_management_contract_count' THEN val END) AS portfolio_management_contract_count FROM latest_val WHERE rn = 1 GROUP BY fmc_id) LEFT JOIN latest_report ON latest_report.fmc_id = fund_management_company.fmc_id → latest_report.certified_practitioner_staff_count
